SEED ARCHITECTURE — applied to Woodside Ranch

Forest Depths #1c3a13 as the only chromatic authority. Snow White #fcfcf7 canvas, never pure white. Lime Pulse #d3fa99 confined to badges. Whisper-light 300-weight headlines with -0.02em tracking. Pill controls at 1000px radius, 16px cards, 32px image cards. Flat throughout — no shadows, no gradients, no elevation.

1200px container, 8px base unit, 64px section gaps.

Seed's product-code treatment (DS-01, DM-02) translates directly to association records: CCR—P1, AM—2026, BUD—[YY].

It does real work here rather than being decoration — a code makes a document citable in a meeting, and gives every file a stable handle that survives renaming.

ONE DELIBERATE DEVIATION

Body copy is set at 400 weight, not 350. The system reserves 400–500 for body, so this stays on-system — chosen because the readership skews older.

Headlines keep the 300 weight. Tap targets are 54–72px.
The two directions from before the Seed reference. Kept for comparison — the Seed direction on page 1 supersedes both.
